pieces.idea: One continuous line, followed by the camera, draws the app one piece at a time: a dumbbell, the load chart with its record, the rest ring, a GPS route, a fork and plate, three habit checks, the coach's bubble. The camera pulls back while the same line draws the phone around all of it (the first dot was its camera), a pulse runs the whole line, and it winds into the G. Loops seamlessly.

pieces.title: Sobrecarga
pieces.idea: Maximalist brand sizzle at 140 BPM with no product in it: the orb charging («CARGANDO ENERGÍA») and blowing, G · I · Z · E one per beat full frame, the logotype assembling with RGB glitch, a diagonal wall of words with a punch word per beat, a grid of 15 brand motifs flipping in waves, the four appearances in circle wipes (TU RITMO · COLOR · ESTILO · MOMENTO), a tunnel of G arcs with CONSTANCIA, half a beat of silence and a 16-cut drop of the logotype. A HUD rides on top (crop marks, timecode, BPM, a spinning «ENTRENÁ CON GIZE» seal), with scanlines and grain. «Sobrecarga» also nods to progressive overload.
pieces.caption:
SOBRECARGA ⚡
Energía en movimiento. Tu ritmo, tu color, tu estilo.
Entrená con GIZE.

Muy pronto, para iPhone y Android.

pieces.title: Checklist pre-entreno ✅
pieces.idea: Checklist format: seven items tick one per beat-and-a-half with a rising note each (the app ones carry an «en GIZE» chip: rutina cargada, la vez pasada, audio del coach, check-in). The eighth, «Ganas de ir 🫠», refuses the tap twice, the music drops («Esta no te la podemos tildar 😅 / Esa la ponés vos.»), then it ticks and LISTO stamps the card.

pieces.title: Top 10 señales de que vas en serio con el gym
pieces.idea: Ranking template: ten empty slots fill from 10 up, one every two beats (sweep, slide, emoji bounce, giant ghost number behind). At #1 the music drops to a drumroll, the camera pushes in on «???» and it lands gold: «Tu rutina está en GIZE».

Top 10 señales de que vas en serio con el gym 🏋️
¿Cuántas cumplís? Contalas en los comentarios 👇

pieces.title: Malo, bueno, excelente
pieces.idea: Three-tier comparison, four rounds: recibir tu rutina (captura borrosa / PDF / en la app con tu peso propuesto), anotar tus series (nada / notas del celu / cada serie con cómo te sentiste), que tu coach te corrija (un 👍 / un mensaje larguísimo / un audio en cada ejercicio), arrancar (el lunes que viene / este lunes / Hoy.). A sad sweep for MALO, a pop for BUENO, a chime and the bit of the app for EXCELENTE; whip cuts between rounds.
pieces.caption:
Malo, bueno, excelente: versión entrenar 🏋️
¿En cuál estás vos? 👀

Spoiler: el excelente empieza hoy.

pieces.title: Entrevista exclusiva: la planilla
pieces.idea: Fake street interview: a mic with the GIZE flag, a night street in bokeh and the old training spreadsheet (rutina_FINAL_v7.xlsx) with a face, telling how an app took its job. Word-by-word captions, babble voices, wide/close hard cuts, punch-in zooms on «GIZE.» and «B12.», a tear, then «Chau planilla. Hola GIZE.».
pieces.caption:
🎤 Entrevista exclusiva: hablamos con la planilla que se quedó sin laburo.
No le corrijan las celdas, está sensible 🥲

Chau planilla. Hola GIZE.

pieces.title: Nadie te ve a esta hora
pieces.idea: Cinematic storytelling with no people, only places and light: cinema bars close in; 6:02, the phone lights the room with a message from the coach; rain on the window; the gym's fluorescent flickers on over a barbell; the phone on the bench with a set ticked and a PR; a montage of weeks cut on the beat; sunrise over the city («Nadie te vio. Pero se nota.»); the bars open on «Entrená con GIZE.».
pieces.caption:
6:02. Nadie te ve a esta hora.
Pero se nota. 🌅

Entrená con GIZE.
